deadline.value: The fall PhD application deadline is December 1 (year inferred for Fall 2027).
deadline.quote: The application deadline for Fall is December 1.

gre_general.value: GRE is not required and is not reviewed.

also.quote: GRE scores are not required to apply for our program and are not reviewed during the application review process.

fee_waiver.value: International applicants can email the program to request a waiver after completing the application; waivers are very competitive and vary by year.
fee_waiver.quote: International applicants may reach out to bme@colorado.edu to request consideration for an application fee waiver after your application is complete and submitted in the online portal.

funding.value: The PhD is fully funded: tuition, most fees and a stipend, for up to six years with satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Our PhD program is fully funded, meaning all admitted students will receive a compensation package that includes the cost of tuition, most student fees, and a cost-of-living stipend.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a baccalaureate degree; a master's is not mentioned as required.
entry_route.quote: Graduate applicants must hold a baccalaureate degree from an accredited college or university

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: The FAQ page still shows the Fall 2026 cycle and a $50 domestic fee; the deadline comes from the PhD program page.
